from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the conductor equality in Varieties Remark 09NW used in the extension-by-zero argument

title: Ideals covering the spectrum of a reduced ring have zero intersection
statement: Let $A$ be a reduced commutative ring and let $I,J\subseteq A$ be ideals such that $V(I)\cup V(J)=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $I\cap J=0$. Consequently, for $B=A/J$, the canonical map $I\to IB=I/(I\cap J)$ is an isomorphism of $A$-modules.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-ideal-intersection], $V(I\cap J)=V(I)\cup V(J)=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$. Thus every prime ideal of $A$ contains $I\cap J$.

source.place: Varieties Remark 09NW (varieties-remark-conductor), equality $\operatorname{Spec}(A)=V(I)\cup V(J)=V(I\cap J)$; Algebra Lemma 00E0 (lemma-Zariski-topology), part (9)

proof.text: Take $x\in I\cap J$. By Step 1, $x$ belongs to every prime ideal. By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-eq-iff-radical-eq], the intersection of all prime ideals is $\sqrt{(0)}$, so $x$ is nilpotent. Reducedness of $A$ means that a nilpotent element is zero. Hence $I\cap J=0$.

source.place: Varieties Remark 09NW (varieties-remark-conductor), assertion that $I\cap J=0$; Algebra Lemma 00E0 (lemma-Zariski-topology), part (7)

proof.text: The quotient map $q:A\to B=A/J$ sends $I$ onto the ideal $IB=(I+J)/J$ by definition. Its restriction $q|_I:I\to IB$ has kernel $\{x\in I:x\in J\}=I\cap J=0$ by Step 2; it is surjective onto $IB$, so it is an $A$-module isomorphism. The quotient description of the same map is $I/(I\cap J)\cong IB$.

proof_origin.place: Varieties Remark 09NW (varieties-remark-conductor); Algebra Lemma 00E0 (lemma-Zariski-topology), parts (7) and (9)

lean.statement: theorem reduced_ideals_zero_intersection {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsReduced A] (I J : Ideal A) (hcover : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ∪ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) = (Set.univ : Set (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of A)))) : I ⊓ J = ⊥ ∧ ∃ e : I ≃ₗ[A] (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) I), ∀ x : I, (e x : A ⧸ J) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (x : A)

reviewed_lean.note: A reduced comm ring: {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsReduced A]; I J : Ideal A; V(I) u V(J) = Spec A: PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus union = Set.univ of AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of A) carrier (defeq PrimeSpectrum A, recorded dep decl); I cap J = 0: I ⊓ J = ⊥; B=A/J, IB = Ideal.map (Quotient.mk J) I; canonical A-linear iso I ≃ₗ[A] IB pinned by e x = mk x (A-action on IB via Submodule.module' scalar tower); IB = I/(I cap J) implied by kernel I ⊓ J = ⊥; edge cases zero ring, I=J, dual numbers excluded by IsReduced
